system.description:
You make a precision attack at the expense of your own defense.

Effect: When wielding only ranged weapons with which you are proficient, you gain a +2 bonus on all your ranged attacks until the beginning of your next turn, but you take a -5 penalty to Reflex Defense.

Special: This Feat cannot be used with Vehicle Weapons or Heavy Weapons.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
